metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · Karthikeya 2
metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Hanu Man
metas.description: An imaginary place called Anjanadri where the protagonist gets the powers of Hanuman and fights for Anjanadri.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · Oke Oka Jeevitham
metas.description: A struggling young musician, along with his two friends, with the help of a quantum physicist goes back in time to prevent the death of his mother. What happens next?

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Mohankrishnas Gang Leader
metas.description: Being a big fan of Chiranjeevi, the protagonist dedicates himself to good deeds and social welfare, helping people and addressing farmers’ agricultural problems.
